chunks: Abu al-Hasan Musa ibn Ja'far عليهما السلام said:
“When you enter the graveyards, step over the graves. Whoever is a believer will find comfort in that, and whoever is a hypocrite will feel its pain.”

key_terms.أَلَمَهُ: his pain; the suffering experienced by him
key_terms.الْمَقَابِرَ: graveyards; the burial places being entered
key_terms.مُؤْمِنًا: a believer; one marked by iman

ai.seo_question: What does Imam Musa al-Kazim عليه السلام say about stepping over graves in the graveyard?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam Musa ibn Ja'far عليهما السلام describes an effect connected to entering graveyards and stepping over graves. It indicates that the believer experiences relief from this act, while the hypocrite experiences pain, pointing to realities connected to the state of the deceased after death.
